_comment: A1 · Auto-Routing · fires on Demand creation. Sets Component from VS Destination, transitions NEW → ROUTED, notifies Lead PM. The format below mirrors Atlassian Automation's rule export structure (UI-importable: Project Settings → Automation → Import rule). Some Atlassian Cloud orgs gate this import; if blocked, recreate manually using the steps in `_steps_human_readable`.
_import_path: Project Settings → Automation → Import rule (or copy the steps below)
name: A1 · Auto-Routing
description: On new Demand: route to correct VS component, notify Lead PM, transition NEW → ROUTED

fields._human_readable: Set Components = same name as VS Destination

actions.subject: [DGTLPROD] New Demand routed to {{issue."DP Value Stream Destination"}}: {{issue.summary}}
actions._note: Replace lookupTable with hard-coded mapping if smart-values lookups aren't enabled in the instance

_steps_human_readable: 2. Condition: Issue type equals Demand Intake.
3. Condition: DP Value Stream Destination is not empty.
4. Action: Edit issue · set Component = same name as DP Value Stream Destination.
6. Action: Send email to Lead PM of that VS (use a smart-value lookup table or hard-coded mapping).
